header.name: Fundamentals of Video for Engineers
header.description: In this course students learn the basic principles of video, its generation, processing, storing and distribution. Topics would include: scanning, interlace/progressive systems, synchronisation, colorometry, Colour encoding system, Colour video standards, Standard Definition TV, Digitisation, Time Base Correction, Standards Conversion, High Definition TV, Conversions, Switchers, routers, signal processors and all modern day studio infrastructure including IP compatible hardware and file based distribution over IT infrastructure. Students will be able to evaluate video hardware, measure and assess its quality and able to design video systems utilizing state of art contemprary hardware. The course will be beneficial for students planning for an executive career in media, entertainment and multuimedia Industry.
